description: An empty labels list for a block type without labels is an error
notes: The README and the documentation of Expand don't limit where the labels attribute can be given, and an empty list gives a block type without labels the right number of labels. hashicorp/hcl reads a dynamic block for a block type without labels with a schema that has no labels argument (dynamicBlockBodySchemaNoLabels in ext/dynblock/schema.go, chosen in expandBody.decodeSpec in expand_spec.go), so any labels attribute is an unexpected argument.
reference_error: An argument named "labels" is not expected here
